Related types: `Accept`, `Impl`, `Instance`, `CombineShape`, `CombineResult`

### AsyncReducer.Accept  _(namespace)_

Convenience type to allow synchronous reducers to be supplied to functions that accept async reducers.

### AsyncReducer.CombineResult  _(namespace)_

Type defining the result type of an async reducer combination for a given shape.

### AsyncReducer.CombineShape  _(namespace)_

Type defining the allowed shape of async reducer combinations.

### AsyncTransformer  _(namespace)_

Related types: `from`, `flatMap`, `flatZip`, `collect`, `intersperse`, `indicesWhere`, `splitWhere`, `splitOn`, `splitOnSlice`, `Accept`, `AcceptNonEmpty`, `NonEmpty`, `window`, `filter`

### AsyncTransformer.Accept  _(namespace)_

Convenience type to allow synchronous transformers to be supplied to functions that accept async transformers.

### AsyncTransformer.AcceptNonEmpty  _(namespace)_

Convenience type to allow non-empty synchronous transformers to be supplied to functions that accept non-empty async transformers.

### AsyncTransformer.collect  _(namespace)_

Returns an `AsyncTransformer` instance that converts or filters its input values using given `collectFun` before passing them to the reducer.

### AsyncTransformer.filter  _(namespace)_

### AsyncTransformer.flatMap  _(namespace)_

Returns an async transformer that applies the given flatMap function to each element of the input stream,

### AsyncTransformer.flatZip  _(namespace)_

Returns an async transformer that applies the given flatMap function to each element of the input stream,

### AsyncTransformer.from  _(namespace)_

Returns an AsyncTransformer based on a given synchronous or asynchronous transformer.

### AsyncTransformer.indicesWhere  _(namespace)_

Returns an `AsyncTransformer` that outputs the index of each received element that satisfies the given predicate.

### AsyncTransformer.intersperse  _(namespace)_

Returns an `AsyncTransformer` that inserts the given `sep` stream source elements between each received input element.

### AsyncTransformer.NonEmpty  _(namespace)_

An AsyncReducer that produces instances `AsyncStreamSource.NonEmpty`.

### AsyncTransformer.splitOn  _(namespace)_

Returns an `AsyncTransformer` that collects the received elements

### AsyncTransformer.splitOnSlice  _(namespace)_

Returns an `AsyncTransformer` that collects the received elements

### AsyncTransformer.splitWhere  _(namespace)_

Returns an `AsyncTransformer` that applies the given `pred` function to each received element, and collects the received elements

### Transformer  _(namespace)_

Related types: `distinctPrevious`, `flatMap`, `flatZip`, `collect`, `intersperse`, `indicesWhere`, `indicesOf`, `splitWhere`, `splitOn`, `splitOnSlice`, `NonEmpty`, `window`, `filter`

### Transformer.collect  _(namespace)_

Returns a `Transformer` instance that converts or filters its input values using given `collectFun` before passing them to the reducer.

### Transformer.distinctPrevious  _(namespace)_

Returns a transformer that returns only those elements from the input that are different to the previous element

### Transformer.filter  _(namespace)_

### Transformer.flatMap  _(namespace)_

Returns a transformer that applies the given flatMap function to each element of the input stream,

### Transformer.flatZip  _(namespace)_

Returns a transformer that applies the given flatMap function to each element of the input stream,

### Transformer.indicesOf  _(namespace)_

Returns a `Transformer` that outputs the index of each received element that is equal to the given `searchValue` value,

### Transformer.indicesWhere  _(namespace)_

Returns a `Transformer` that outputs the index of each received element that satisfies the given predicate.

### Transformer.intersperse  _(namespace)_

Returns a `Transformer` that inserts the given `sep` stream source elements between each received input element.

### Transformer.NonEmpty  _(namespace)_

A Reducer that produces instances of `StreamSource.NonEmpty`.

### Transformer.splitOn  _(namespace)_

Returns a `Transformer` that collects the received elements

### Transformer.splitOnSlice  _(namespace)_

Returns a `Transformer` that collects the received elements

### Transformer.splitWhere  _(namespace)_

Returns a `Transformer` that applies the given `pred` function to each received element, and collects the received elements

### Transformer.window  _(namespace)_

## @rimbu/task

### all  _(const, advanced)_

Executes multiple Tasks concurrently and waits for all to complete.

### allSettled  _(const, advanced)_

Executes multiple Tasks concurrently and waits for all to settle (either resolve or reject).

### any  _(const, advanced)_

Executes multiple Tasks concurrently and returns the result of the first Task to successfully complete.

### cancelAllChildren  _(const, advanced)_

### cancelContext  _(const, advanced)_

### catchAll  _(const)_

Catches all errors thrown by a Task and allows for handling them with a provided Task.

### catchError  _(const)_

Catches errors thrown by a Task and allows for handling them with a provided function.

### chain  _(const, advanced)_

Chains multiple Tasks together, executing them sequentially.

### cleanupOn  _(const)_

### cleanupToCallback  _(const)_

### combined  _(const)_

Combines multiple Task modifiers into a single modifier.

### delay  _(const, advanced)_

Creates a Task that delays execution for a specified number of milliseconds.
